mapper.sql: id, user_id, user_type, title, content, type, biz_type, biz_id, is_read, create_time, read_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_notification (user_id, user_type, title, content, type, biz_type, biz_id, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_notification SET is_read = 1, read_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_read = 0
UPDATE sys_notification SET is_read = 1, read_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_type = #{userType} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_type = #{userType} AND is_read = 0
